summary: The A4 prefill option no longer changes the input scales of FP4-activation MoE plans
compatibility: Only matters with B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS set; W4A16 plans behave as before.
details: With B12X_W4A16_A4_PREFILL_MIN_TOKENS set, weight preparation reduced the input scale to the smallest expert scale for every MoE plan, so FP4-activation (W4A4) plans would have quantized all experts with the widest calibrated range. The option now applies to W4A16 plans only.
